# ankra_cluster_access_grants (Data Source)

Lists the kubectl access grants on a cluster, those from roles and the creator seed included. The counterpart of `ankra cluster access list`. Only organisation admins may read it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster_access_grants" "prod" {
  cluster_id = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `grants` (Attributes List) Grants that are not revoked, newest first. A grant past its expiry stays listed until the platform retires it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))
- `id` (String) The cluster id.

<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Read-Only:

- `ankra_user_id` (String) Identifier of the member.
- `expires_at` (String) When the grant ends; null for a standing grant.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the grant.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of a namespace grant.
- `reason` (String) Recorded justification.
- `reconcile_status` (String) Whether the binding is applied on the cluster.
- `role` (String) `view`, `edit`, `admin` or `cluster-admin`.
- `scope` (String) `cluster` or `namespace`.
- `source` (String) `manual`, `creator`, `role` or `elevated`.
- `user_email` (String) Email of the member.
